Tambaram is in demand among home buyers as it offers the convenience of city living with the comfort of a residential locality. With rail connectivity, schools, hospitals, and access to GST Road, it has multiple nooks and crannies for you to explore.

When it comes to the land rate in Tambaram, selecting the right area is as crucial as looking at the costs. At Omshakthy Homes, we know that purchasing a plot is about finding a place that suits your way of living, your budget and your plans for the future.

Why to Buy Plots in Tambaram?

Tambaram, a suburb of Chennai city, is also well connected to the ancient city and is now juxtaposed with the rapidly growing southern suburbs of Chennai. Tambaram also has the convenience of a suburban railway station, bus services, and GST Road to make daily travel easier. For families looking for a house site in Tambaram, they can choose either among established neighborhoods or new residential communities.

Some of the advantages are:

  • Suburban railway and bus connectivity
  • Schools, colleges, and hospitals within reach
  • Developed shopping and residential localities
  • Connected to GST Road and the neighbouring towns
  • Various plot sizes and housing options

In the end, the best location depends on your daily commute, budget, and desired environment.

Best Places to Buy Plots in Tambaram

Anyone scouting residential land in Tambaram will find that each locality below offers a different mix of connectivity, amenities and pricing.

  • East Tambaram: Established Residential Living. East Tambaram is an ideal choice for families looking for an established neighborhood with all schools, colleges and daily amenities within reach. For those looking for plots in East Tambaram, it is important to consider the access of internal roads, the plot size available and how far it is from the services you need. Exploring the area at peak traffic times will give you a better idea of your commute.
  • West Tambaram: Excellent Accessibility to Everyday Needs. West Tambaram is accessible to the railway station, bus services, shopping malls and businesses and GST Road. If you are looking at plots in West Tambaram, focus on how far away the property is from main roads and public transportation. Verify the traffic, drainage, and the adjacent streets before you decide.
  • Selaiyur: A Convenient Choice for Families. Selaiyur has a well-established residential area and schools, colleges, shops and hospitals are available. Families looking for plots near Tambaram can consider this area for their best options. Keep in mind the distance from your workplace, the nearby amenities and the condition of the internal roads while you choose a plot.
  • Mudichur and Varadharajapuram: Explore Planned Communities. Mudichur and Varadharajapuram provide options beyond Tambaram's traditional residential areas. Prospective buyers can consider plot developments and browse for land sizes, road access and neighborhood amenities. But be especially wary of drainage and flood exposure. Research the property's history and personally inspect the site before buying.
  • Perungalathur: Convenience to GST Road. Perungalathur is also a place worth seeing along Chennai's southern corridor. Owing to its good suburban railway connectivity and availability of GST Road, it is of great advantage to those with a frequent travel routine. See how far available homes are from the station, schools, shops, and highways. A site visit will give you a better understanding of the community.

Why Railway Connectivity Matters

For people who commute regularly, plots near Tambaram railway station may be worth considering.

Good access to suburban rail can also facilitate travel to other parts of Chennai. But proximity should not be the only factor in your choice. Verify real travel time, public transportation options, and traffic situation, as well as distance by road, before buying.

Know About Plot Prices in Tambaram

The plot rate in Tambaram varies according to various factors like the location of the property, the area of the property or the length of the road frontage, whether you have obtained layout approval, and proximity to nearby infrastructure. Homes in mature neighborhoods may be offered at a premium to homes in newer communities.

While you are comparing prices, consider these extra charges also:

  • Stamp duty and the cost of registration
  • Legal vetting fees
  • Maintenance charges, if any
  • Preparation of the site and cost of buildings

Have the developer or seller provide you with a detailed price breakdown before you make any payment.

Things to Consider Before Buying a Plot

If you are going to buy land in Tambaram, then considering the legal documents of the property must be an essential part of your decision.

These are the five mandatory checks:

  • Ownership: Check the title deed, the parent documents, and the chain of ownership.
  • Encumbrance Certificate: Download EC online and verify the registration documents.
  • Details of the Survey: Verify the survey number, sub-division, patta, plot size and so on.
  • Approved Layout: Locate your plot and be certain the layout is approved.
  • Site Conditions: Neighbors, perimeter borders, drainage, and roads leading to the site.

DTCP and CMDA Approvals

CMDA approved plots in Tambaram must have their layout approval number and plan confirmed with the relevant authority. There are other plots in Tambaram that have been approved by the DTCP.

When you shortlist DTCP approved plots in Tambaram, ask the seller to show the specific approval number so you can verify it with the authority directly.

The specific authority differs depending on the location and size of the property. Keep in mind that layout sanction does not confer clear ownership. Check the title deeds, the applicable RERA registration and any other relevant documents.

How to Choose the Right Plot in Tambaram

Finding the right plot starts with understanding your priorities.

If you are looking for a home in a developed region or an emerging residential zone, be sure to consider how the home or office space suits your daily routine. Keep these few things in mind when looking for plots for sale in Tambaram:

  • Location: Choose a suitable area that matches your daily commute and lifestyle.
  • Budget: Consider the cost of the property and other buying expenses.
  • Transport: Check if you can easily get to the trains and buses from where you live.
  • Legal papers: Know the ownership documents, layout approvals, and any other applicable papers.
  • Future plans: Decide if you want to build a house right away or hold the plot for later.

When you take the time to compare properties, it'll definitely help you buy wisely.
